title: Siberian Next module manifest
description: Declared at the root of a module as module.yml. Read by the Orchestrator at install and update time. Everything the core grants a module is granted from this file, never inferred at runtime.

name.description: Stable identifier. Becomes the internal DNS short name and the container name segment. Never changes across versions.

containers.description: Containers the Orchestrator creates for this module. Each is named <uuid>-<module_name>-<service>.

role.description: http containers can be routed to. datastore containers are never reachable from outside the module network.

base.description: Base path the Router mounts this module at.

entry.description: Name of the http container that serves this module's UI.

origin.description: Subdomain label for the module's own origin (<origin>.apps.<domain>). Defaults to name. The separate origin is what makes the Base App iframe a browser-enforced boundary rather than a convention.

native.description: What this module contributes to the domain's phone app. Optional: a module that declares nothing native still appears in the app, as a WebView on the UI the Base App already frames.

entry.description: React Native entry point, relative to the module directory.

screens.description: One per feature capability this module renders natively. A capability with no native screen falls back on its own.

capability.description: Feature capability id this screen renders. Must be one this module provides.

component.description: Exported component name in the entry point.

requires.description: Native capabilities this module needs. A request an operator approves at install, never a switch: a capability an operator has not enabled leaves this module's native screen off.

fallback.description: What the app shows when this module's native code is unavailable.

permissions.description: Everything the module is allowed to reach. Granted at install or update time on the Android model: the operator sees this list and approves it. Nothing outside this list is reachable.

name.description: Provision a database owned by this module under this logical name.

target.description: Reach an existing database instead of provisioning one. Mutually exclusive with name.

access.description: owner applies to provisioned databases. read is the default grant on an existing target; write is granted deliberately.

scope.description: per_domain gives one database per domain, which is how domain isolation works. global is a single shared database and needs justification.

tables.description: Named tables in the target database this module may read. Required when target is set: reaching into a database somebody else owns is granted table by table, never wholesale, and every grant is written to the audit trail.

reason.description: Why this module needs the access. Shown to the operator on the install review screen. Required for a target grant, because an operator cannot approve what nobody explained.

modules.description: Other modules this one may call over the internal API.

storage.description: File storage. Granted spaces are created at install time; a module with no storage block gets none at all.

spaces.description: files is private and durable, tmp is swept on a TTL, public is served by the Router at /-/public/<path>.

capabilities.description: What the module offers the rest of the system, and what it can make use of. Two kinds, because they extend different things: system capabilities extend the core (mail transport, authentication, cache), feature capabilities extend the product the user sees. Auto-discovery reads all of it, which is what lets workflows be composed without either side hardcoding the other.

consumes.description: Capabilities of either kind this module would like to use if something provides them. An unmatched request is not an error; it is a feature that stays switched off.

system.description: Extends the core. A system capability implements a named interface the core already knows how to call, so the core can route mail, authentication, or caching through this module instead of, or alongside, its built-in service. It has no UI and no area.

id.description: Globally unique, dotted. Convention: <module>.<subject>.<role>, for example acme.mail.transport.

interface.description: The core interface this implements, including its version, for example mail.transport.v1. The core calls it through this contract and nothing else.

endpoint.description: Path on the module's internal API where the core reaches this implementation.

priority.description: Lower wins when several modules implement the same interface. The core's own service is 1000, so any module outranks it unless it says otherwise.

exclusive.description: Whether this implementation replaces others for the interface rather than joining them. Two exclusive providers of one interface is an install-time conflict.

features.description: Extends the application the user sees. A feature capability is a page or a fragment the Base App lists or links in a named area.

id.description: Globally unique, dotted. Convention: <module>.<subject>.<role>, for example crm.contact.viewer.

area.description: Named area of the Base App where this capability is listed or linked.

accepts.description: Capability ids or subject types this endpoint can be handed.
